name: Invented Arithmetic
description: Nine small number puzzles with tidy answers.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Nine small number puzzles to think about, shown on Brain Teasers.
help.goal: Nothing to win. Think it over, then reveal the answer when you are ready.
howToPlay: Read the teaser and take your time.
Press Hint for a nudge, if there is one.
Press Reveal answer to see the answer and why.
tips: Scribbling on paper is allowed. So is skipping.
